LiF is a different chemical family from the phosphate tried so far.

proposal.hypothesis: Li3AlSiO5 is a Li-rich aluminosilicate built from Al3+ and Si4+, both very hard to reduce. It should be a wide-gap insulator that is oxidatively stable near 4 V against LiCoO2. proposal.hypothesis: Li3BO3 is a Li-rich orthoborate built only from B3+ and Li+, neither of which is easily reduced by Li6PS5Cl.
